title: gasometer
description: How much of an EVM transaction fee was unnecessary, measured live on Avalanche C-Chain, Base and Optimism.

options.content:
### How much of each transaction fee was unnecessary
Every minute, on each network, gasometer prices a native transfer three ways and checks which blocks it would have landed in within 30 seconds. **Red is what was paid above the cheapest price that landed.**

- **Market** bids the median tip of the latest block: what senders are paying.
- **Node** bids the node's suggested tip, `eth_maxPriorityFeePerGas`.
- **gasometer** bids the 0.99 quantile of the cheapest tip that landed in recent 30 s windows.
- **Tip needed** is the 5th percentile tip a block included (the lowest on C-Chain), an upper bound on what inclusion needed.

The fee model is built on Avalanche's [libevm](https://github.com/ava-labs/libevm), and C-Chain's base fee on [avalanchego](https://github.com/ava-labs/avalanchego)'s SAE gas clock.

**GitHub:** [`github.com/BenWolfaardt/gasometer`](https://github.com/BenWolfaardt/gasometer)
